subject: SecureBank CAIQ: evidence packaging and control mapping cadence
messages:
From: Caroline Lund <caroline.lund@securebank.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security-audit@securebank.com
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ export + evidence ask (deadline Feb 12)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. SecureBank is running a targeted CAIQ review focused on production data flows and key management controls for vendors that handle derived embeddings. Our auditor has asked for a CAIQ response (completed CSA JSON/CSV or spreadsheet) plus supporting artifacts for 30 representative controls by Feb 12.

Attached is our intake (SecureBank_CAIQ_Request.pdf) with the prioritized controls and a sample evidence checklist. High level asks:
- Completed CAIQ mapping with control statement and where the evidence lives (link or artifact name).
- Evidence: architecture diagrams, KMS rotation logs, access-control policy excerpts, runtime logs sample, and SOC2 evidence if available.
- Point-of-contact and owner for each control.

Are you able to deliver a first-pass mapping by Feb 3 and a finalized package by Feb 11? Also please confirm whether you can provide a redactable evidence bundle (we can accept redacted screenshots for keys and tokens).

Would appreciate a single sheet that shows Redwood control -> SecureBank CAIQ ID -> artifact reference. If you have a template, please share.

Best,
Caroline
Caroline Lund
Senior Manager, Third-Party Risk
SecureBank

Attachment: SecureBank_CAIQ_Request.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

From: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Lund <caroline.lund@securebank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ export + evidence ask (deadline Feb 12)

Caroline — thanks for the clear intake (and the deadline). We can commit to the Feb 3 first-pass and Feb 11 final package.

Plan I propose (high-level):
1) We’ll run a CAIQ crosswalk against your prioritized list and populate the spreadsheet with Redwood control references and evidence locations.
2) Marissa will lead evidence collation for security controls (KMS, audit logs, SOC2 artifacts).
3) Engineering (Prioym) will pull runtime logs samples and ownership details for production services.
4) Kimberly will own the artifact delivery cadence and provide the redactable bundle.

Can you clarify whether the scope excludes non-production environments? Also — do you require hashed token exposures in logs or only access-control screenshots and rotation proof?

I attached our starter mapping template (redwood_caiq_mapping_template.xlsx) and a short ownership matrix stub.

We’ll aim to share the first-pass on Feb 3 (spreadsheet + a short gap memo). If that works I’ll schedule a 30-min checkpoint next Wed.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_template.xlsx (xlsx), service-ownership-matrix.csv (csv)

From: Caroline Lund <caroline.lund@securebank.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security-audit@securebank.com
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ export + evidence ask (deadline Feb 12)

Diego — that plan sounds good. Scope: production systems only. For logs, we only need evidence that rotation and access controls are enforced; hashed tokens are not required. Screenshots + export snippets are fine, redacted as needed.

Two quick notes:
- We added a small follow-up item in the intake: a request for the last 12 months of KMS key rotation metadata for the master envelope key (if you can provide rotation stamps/logs).
- There is a Drive tracker we prefer vendors to use (helps our audit team): https://drive.google.com/securebank-audit/tracker-94X. If you can drop evidence links there we will pull them directly.

I’ll accept the Feb 3 draft. Please mark items you anticipate will take longer.

Thanks,
Caroline

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 01 Feb 2027 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: SecureBank CAIQ - evidence packaging plan

Team — taking point on this. Below is the suggested evidence delivery blueprint to meet their Feb 11 final package. I’ll post artifacts to the SecureBank Drive tracker and flag items that contain sensitive information for redaction.

Proposed owner matrix (high level):
- KMS & key rotation metadata: Marissa (collect from KMS audit exports) — expected artifact: kms_rotation_log_2026-12.csv
- SOC2 / policy excerpts (encrypt at rest, access reviews): Marissa — citations to SOC2 workbook and policy excerpts (PDF snippets)
- Runtime logs (production inference nodes): Prioym — 3 sample 24-hour slices with PII/token redaction notes (logs delivered as .log snippets)
- Architecture diagram & network flow: Kimberly — redacted diagram highlighting data flow and control points (attachment: network-flow-redacted.pdf placeholder)
- Control ownership mapping: Diego — complete the spreadsheet mapping (redwood_caiq_mapping_template.xlsx)

Deliverable timeline:
- Feb 3: First-pass spreadsheet with 30 prioritized controls marked (status: owned / needs artifacts / vendor action).
- Feb 6: Midpoint checkpoint — sample artifacts uploaded for 12 controls.
- Feb 11: Final bundle (zipped) and index file.

Artifact naming convention: <SecureBankID>_<RedwoodControl>_<artifact-type> (e.g., SB-CAIQ-3_KMS_rotation_csv).

Notes on KMS request: we can provide the rotation metadata with timestamps and user/service principal IDs. We will redact principal IDs to hashed identifiers and provide the raw mapping to SecureBank under an NDA if required.

I’ll start pulling the KMS export and SOC2 excerpts today. Prioym — can you confirm ETA for logs?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): kms_rotation_log_2026-12.csv (csv stub), service-ownership-matrix.csv (csv)

From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 08:52:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: SecureBank CAIQ - evidence packaging plan

Marissa — I can pull the runtime logs. ETA: Feb 4 for the 3 sample slices. Plan is to sanitize tokens, replace any user identifiers with consistent hashed IDs, and provide a short README describing sanitization steps. I’ll put uploads into the Drive tracker under /redwood-evidence/securebank/.

One caveat: for log retention exports we need to coordinate exact query windows so we don’t include irrelevant debug logs. Diego — can you confirm which Redwood service names count as "production inference nodes" for SecureBank? I think it’s inference-prod-{us,eu} and embeddings-prod only, but want to be explicit.

Subject: Re: CAIQ export + evidence ask (deadline Feb 12)

Caroline — quick alignment note.

We confirm:
- Feb 3: first-pass spreadsheet (redwood_caiq_mapping_template.xlsx) with owners marked and initial artifact links in your Drive tracker.
- Feb 4: runtime log slices uploaded (sanitized) to the tracker.
- Feb 11: final zipped evidence package and index.

We will redact principal IDs in KMS exports and provide hashed mappings to SecureBank under an access agreement. If SecureBank prefers raw principal mapping for audit purposes we can discuss a secure transfer channel.

Action items for SecureBank:
- Confirm that redaction with hashed IDs is acceptable for KMS principal identifiers.
- Confirm list of Redwood services considered "production inference" (we will assume inference-prod-us, inference-prod-eu, embeddings-prod until you confirm).

Thanks — I’ll create the 30-min checkpoint invite for Feb 6 and share the Drive folder link when artifacts start flowing.

Best,
Diego
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
